en: Black‑and‑white photograph of an old Gothic doorway on a narrow cobblestone street. The central pointed‑arch door has wooden panels with tracery, reached by a few worn stone steps. Above it is a large stone relief panel in a Gothic frame showing several kneeling figures around a heraldic shield or religious scene. Flanking the doorway are fragments of elaborate Gothic carvings and another pointed arch to the right. On the left is a small window with metal lattice bars and flower pots. The façade is rough and peeling, suggesting great age. At the very bottom edge, some hand‑written characters appear on the print border.
